scene.line: Contract ID: Shadow-041. Time: 02:13 AM. Sender: N.
Destroy the target marked “cargo.” Do it properly this time.
East District Power Station // Akai gang stronghold
The cargo is held by the criminal organization “Akai gang.” Break through the outer strongholds first. The Warden will be waiting. He has always been waiting.
Paid upon confirmed destruction. Previous payments: uncollected.
Don't ask what the cargo is. Leave no witnesses. Don't hesitate.
What the hell?! Did you just come out of the lightning?!
Who are you? You don't walk in here like you've been invited. Leave before I lose my temper.
Next you'll say I'm looking for trouble.
Looking for... how did you know that? Fine. Trouble it is.
Over here!! Somebody's on the roof! We're under attack!
Take him down!!
When is this rain going to stop? My boots are soaked through.
Quit whining. We'll grab a drink upstairs after this shift.
Wait. Someone's over there.
That thing in the warehouse is scratching at the crate again.
Don't go near it. The boss said the Warden feeds it himself.
It's gone quiet downstairs. Intruder!
Is the Warden still upstairs?
He hasn't moved from his post in three days. Nobody gets past him.
Somebody's about to. Open fire!
Why are the alarms downstairs all lit up?
Hold the stairs. Whatever it takes, he doesn't reach the top floor.
Got him! Under the platform!
Isn't the Warden coming down to help?
He won't leave. His orders are to guard the cargo, and he takes those orders personally.
Target on the top floor! Crossfire!
Stop. You break into someone's home and cut down his people. Don't you think that's rude?
Yes. It is.
Hm. Honest, at least. Odd. I feel like I've heard that answer before.
You have.
Fine. Let's see how honest you stay after I tear off both your legs.
You know my moves. Every one of them. Like you've bled on this floor before.
Forty times.
Forty... That's it, isn't it? You're not here for the Akai. You're here to...
The power station's underground warehouse. Forty contracts have ended in this room. The target sits under the same lamp.
No ID. No warning. Just a damp wooden crate that he already knows by heart.
Shadow draws his blade. One strike. He has done this so many times he could do it asleep.
Meow.
The lid slowly springs open. The thing inside is trembling. The blade in his hand starts to hum.

barks.line: Kneel now, and you'll still die in one piece.
You really think you can walk into Akai territory?
One more step and I'll chop you to pieces.
You look more like a stray dog than a hunter.
Rain's been bad all night. Lucky you showed up to give me something to do.
Don't move! Move again and I'll shoot!
Can you dodge the first shot?
Whatever you came for, the cargo isn't worth it.
This is the end of the road for you.
